tagline: Search and AI visibility platform with backlink verification and monitoring.
verdictSummary: A personal visibility tracker for one site — pull real Search Console data, ask a fixed set of buyer questions across a few AI model APIs, crawl your own sitemap for technical issues — is a real weekend build. What doesn't come with it is verified backlink data, a cross-site partner network, and the managed, always-on monitoring that catches a lost mention before you'd notice.
coreLoopDIY: Track one site's real Search Console performance and sample a fixed set of buyer questions across a few AI model APIs, ranking the pages and queries that need attention.
whatYouLose: exact visibility into every AI-search surface
a cross-site partner network and marketplace
whyPeopleStillPay: People pay for verified backlink and traffic data, checks across multiple AI models, and a partner network — without maintaining the API integrations and scheduled jobs themselves.
notes: A strong kinda: the solo monitoring loop is genuinely reachable, but the external data and partner network are the actual product.
prompt:
Build a local search and AI-visibility tracker for one site you own: connect Google Search Console through OAuth and import clicks, impressions, click-through rate, and average position by query and page for the last several weeks. Store a fixed list of buyer-relevant questions, and on demand, ask each one through a few different model APIs, recording the answers, any citations, and whether your brand or domain gets mentioned. Show recent Search Console changes, a per-model mention rate, and a history trend for each tracked question on a simple dashboard. Crawl your own sitemap periodically, recording page status, title, canonical tags, noindex flags, and broken internal links. Build a prioritized action list — lost AI mentions first, falling Search Console pages second, broken or noindex pages third — with every item linking back to its evidence.

Do not build backlink data collection, a partner network, or competitor tracking — that data can't be self-collected at any reasonable effort, and it's the actual moat behind the subscription.

faq.q: Can I import my existing VerifiedDR data?
faq.a: Not really — its backlink and monitoring data live inside its own platform with no export. Your Search Console data, though, is yours regardless and connects the same way here.

faq.q: Will it work on my phone?
faq.a: The dashboard is a small local web page, viewable on a phone if exposed on your network, but there's no dedicated app and no push alerts for a lost mention.

faq.q: What does it actually cost to run?
faq.a: Search Console access is free; API calls across a few model providers for the buyer-question checks cost a small amount per run, typically a few cents to a few dollars depending on frequency.

faq.q: What's the one thing that genuinely doesn't survive the rebuild?
faq.a: Verified backlink data. Domain-rating and backlink numbers require crawling the web at a scale no personal project can match — that visibility only exists because the platform already did the crawling.
